page_title: ESP 1-1 ATM | Espanyol v Atletico Madrid 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Exposito (Espanyol) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
90+2' Exposito (Espanyol) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card. Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) will miss the next game.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) is brought on as a substitute for Javi Puado.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
88' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.

88' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
87' CHANCE! Rodrigo de Paul finds Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
84' It will be a substitution. Fernando Calero (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Urko Gonzalez walks off.

82' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time low shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Joan Garcia denies him.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Conor Gallagher as he is replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
81' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) replaces Cesar Azpilicueta.
80' The corner kick from Exposito (Espanyol) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
79' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pere Milla (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch for Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
77' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
75' The attendance is 30559.
73' The referee is firm and issues Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) a deserved yellow card.
71' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Javi Puado (Espanyol) high into the middle of the goal, giving goalkeeper Jan Oblak no chance!
71' Javi Puado (Espanyol) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
69' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola signals a set piece. The referee points to the penalty spot. Espanyol are awarded a penalty kick!
67' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes the corner with a short pass.

67' A cross is whipped into the box by Javi Puado (Espanyol) and Alejo Veliz controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. Good work from Espanyol as they win a corner.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) for Alexander Sorloth.
64' A substitution has been made. Giuliano Simeone is replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
62' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Alex Kral is replaced by Exposito (Espanyol).
62' Substitution. Antoniu Roca in, Jofre (Espanyol) out.
61' Jofre (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but Jan Oblak comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Jofre (Espanyol) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
59' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

55' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Javier Alberola blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
51' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
50' Alex Kral (Espanyol) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
48' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
47' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
46' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Alejo Veliz comes on the pitch for Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Simeone gives a chance to Rodrigo de Paul and Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' PENALTY APPEAL after Jofre (Espanyol) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Alex Kral (Espanyol) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
44' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

41' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome. The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.
41' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
40' Javier Alberola blows his whistle after Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Espanyol.
38' 0 - 1 Absolutely fantastic goal! Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies into the top left corner. Take a bow.
37' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Joan Garcia.

37' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' Total attempts – 4:3. The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
34' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
31' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Cesar Azpilicueta, but he puts too much power on the pass.
30' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola signals a foul.
28' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.

28' It looks like Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Diego Simeone replaces him with Jose Maria Gimenez.

26' The game is interrupted now, Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on. Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

25' Jan Oblak doesn't have to worry about that one. Omar El Hilali puts a cross in towards Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the left post.
23' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
22' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' Atl. Madrid have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
21' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

20' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
19' Alex Kral (Espanyol) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
19' Jofre (Espanyol) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' A cross into the box from Jofre (Espanyol) is cleared.
17' The number of offsides is – 0:3.
16' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) offside.
15' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Alexander Sorloth, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
13' Jofre (Espanyol) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
10' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball forward to Samuel Lino, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
8' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
8' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
8' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.

8' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) plays a terrific long ball forward to Jofre, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
3' A goal, which was scored by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid), was disallowed due to offside.
2' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
2' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) sends a long ball forward to Carlos Romero, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
